description: Find the CPE vendor and product names that hold a text, ranked by vulnerable CVE count. Pass a name that holds no % as it is to the vendor and product arguments of the cve_search, cve_triage, cve_leading and product_exposure tools.

search.description: Text in vendor or product names, at least 3 bytes; case does not matter, and _ matches a space
